(Capacity: 1,000) |champion= |bowl=[[2017 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CIT]] |bowl_result=First Round }} {{2016–17 Southland Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 [[Houston Baptist Huskies men's basketball]] team''' represented [[Houston Baptist University]] in the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The season was head coach [[Ron Cottrell]]'s 26th season at HBU. The Huskies played their home games at [[Sharp Gymnasium]] as members of the [[Southland Conference]]. They finished the season 17–14, 12–6 in Southland play to finish in a three-way tie for second place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2017 Southland Conference men's basketball tournament|Southland tournament]] to [[2016–17 Sam Houston State Bearkats men's basketball team|Sam Houston State]]. The Huskies received an invitation to the [[2017 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CollegeInsider.com Tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2016–17 Campbell Fighting Camels basketball team|Campbell]]. == Previous season == The [[2015–16 Houston Baptist Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 17–17, 10–8 in [[2015–16 Southland Conference men's basketball season|Southland play]] to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2015–16 Southeastern Louisiana Lions basketball team|Southeastern Louisiana]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 Southland Conference men's basketball tournament|Southland tournament]] before losing to [[2015–16 Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks basketball team|Stephen F. Austin]] in the semifinals. The Huskies received an invitation to the [[2016 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where they lost in the first round to [[2015–16 UNC Greensboro Spartans men's basketball team|UNC Greensboro]]. ==Media== All Houston Baptist games were broadcast online live by the Legacy Sports Network (LSN). LSN also provided online video for every non-televised Huskies home game.
